basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Geomagnetism (IIG), an autonomous body under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India, is engaging one Consultant (Finance & Accounts) at its headquarters in Panvel, and resumes are to be emailed to [email protected] by 30 November 2026. The position is open to retired officers from Central Autonomous Institutes, preferably IITs, NITs and IIITs, and the walk-in interview is on 1 December 2026 in hybrid mode.

qualification.details: One post of Consultant (Finance & Accounts) is advertised. The position is purely temporary, initially for a period of one year. | Minimum qualification: Graduate in any discipline. The candidate should be a retired or due to retire Assistant Accounts Officer/Section Officer (Accounts/Audit) from Central Govt. Depts./PSU/Central Autonomous Bodies, or an equivalent grade officer with grade pay of Rs.4600/- / Rs.4800/-, equivalent Pay level not lower than 7 / 8 as per 7th CPC. The candidate should be well-versed with budget related procedures, General Financial Rules (GFR), Finance & Accounts Rules and FR & SR. The candidate should have experience with Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) and audit procedures. The candidate should be proficient in the Public Financial Management System (PFMS). The candidate should have expertise in Government Accounting Practices, Budgeting and Financial Management. | Degree in Finance from a recognized university. Knowledge of computer applications, and ability to work independently. | The remuneration is a fixed monthly amount as per Department of Expenditure's O.M. No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020, read with Department of Expenditure OM No. 03-25/2020- E.III(A)/Pt. dated 18.10.2023. Apart from the consolidated remuneration, no perquisites such as HRA, DA or residential accommodation will be provided. Retired employees engaged as consultants may be allowed TA/DA on official tour, if any, as per their entitlement at the time of retirement. For a part time Consultant, a pro rata honorarium can be paid as per applicable rules. Income tax or any other tax liable to be deducted will be deducted at source, and the office will issue a TDS certificate. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

important_instructions: The engagement is purely on a short term contract basis, initially for one year. It may be extended or curtailed depending on performance or the functional requirement of the Office, with the approval of the Competent Authority. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates called for the interview, or for joining the assignment or on its completion. Working hours are 9.30 AM to 6.00 PM on working days, including half an hour lunch break. The Consultant may be called on Saturday, Sunday or other gazetted holidays if required, and must mark attendance in the biometric system. The Consultant is not entitled to regular leave. Casual leave is 1.5 days for each completed month of service, and it lapses at the end of the annual contract if not used within the calendar year. The Consultant may be called for services on holidays or beyond normal working hours, with no extra remuneration. The Consultant may not take any other assignment during the engagement, and may not give opinion or advice adverse to the interest of the Institute. Intellectual Property Rights of the data and deliverables remain with the office. The Consultant must hand over the entire set of records before the contract expires and before the final payment is released. The engagement may be terminated at any time without assigning any reason. A consultant who wishes to leave must give 30 days' notice, which can be curtailed or extended depending on the workload. The person engaged will not be treated on par with regular employees of IIG and has no right to claim absorption or regularization.

content_sections.heading: About IIG
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Geomagnetism is an autonomous institute under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India. Its address is Plot No.5, Sector-18, Kalamboli Highway, New Panvel, Navi Mumbai. The notice describes the institute as being under the Ministry of Science & Technology in the body text and under the Department of Science and Technology on the letterhead.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested candidates may send a detailed resume with PPO, experience in chronological order and any other supporting documents, all in a single pdf, to [email protected] by 30 November 2026. The notice does not specify an email subject line or an application form. The walk-in interview is on 01.12.2026 (Tuesday) at Indian Institute of Geomagnetism, Plot No.5, Sector-18, Kalamboli Highway, New Panvel, Navi Mumbai – 410 218. The mode of interview is Hybrid. The notice does not print a reporting time.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: One post of Consultant (Finance & Accounts) is advertised. The position is purely temporary, initially for a period of one year. Minimum qualification: Graduate in any discipline. The candidate should be a retired or due to retire Assistant Accounts Officer/Section Officer (Accounts/Audit) from Central Govt. Depts./PSU/Central Autonomous Bodies, or an equivalent grade officer with grade pay of Rs.4600/- / Rs.4800/-, equivalent Pay level not lower than 7 / 8 as per 7th CPC. The candidate should be well-versed with budget related procedures, General Financial Rules (GFR), Finance & Accounts Rules and FR & SR. The candidate should have experience with Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) and audit procedures. The candidate should be proficient in the Public Financial Management System (PFMS). The candidate should have expertise in Government Accounting Practices, Budgeting and Financial Management. Degree in Finance from a recognized university. Knowledge of computer applications, and ability to work independently. The remuneration is a fixed monthly amount as per Department of Expenditure's O.M. No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020, read with Department of Expenditure OM No. 03-25/2020- E.III(A)/Pt. dated 18.10.2023. Apart from the consolidated remuneration, no perquisites such as HRA, DA or residential accommodation will be provided. Retired employees engaged as consultants may be allowed TA/DA on official tour, if any, as per their entitlement at the time of retirement. For a part time Consultant, a pro rata honorarium can be paid as per applicable rules. Income tax or any other tax liable to be deducted will be deducted at source, and the office will issue a TDS certificate. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIG Recruitment 2026?

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIG Consultant post?
faq.answer: Resumes are to be emailed to [email protected] by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIG Consultant (Finance & Accounts) post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is Graduate in any discipline. The candidate should also be a retired or due to retire Assistant Accounts Officer/Section Officer (Accounts/Audit) or an equivalent grade officer. A Degree in Finance is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply for this IIG post?
faq.answer: The institute invites applications from retired officers from Central Autonomous Institutes, preferably IITs, NITs and IIITs. The eligibility line also covers officers due to retire from Central Govt. Depts., PSUs or Central Autonomous Bodies.

faq.answer: The interview is held on 1 December 2026 at Indian Institute of Geomagnetism, Plot No.5, Sector-18, Kalamboli Highway, New Panvel, Navi Mumbai – 410 218.
